newsitem.title: USA: Orbital Sciences gets $50 mln NASA contract.
newsitem.headline: Orbital Sciences gets $50 mln NASA contract.

text.p: Orbital Sciences Corp said Tuesday it had finalized a $50 million contract with the National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA) for design, developent and testing of the X-34 reusable technology demonstration vehicle.

The company said the contract also includes an option that NASA can exercise at a later date for up to 25 flights conducted by Orbital during a 12-month period after the two flights in the basic contract. The option value to Orbital is $16.7 million, the company said.
The company said its work on the basic contract begins immediately and will last until January 1999.
